scores.tell: Glass ball is slightly too uniformly glossy, with one hard white glare; the stand, wood ledge and diamond backdrop all match the real cards
The maps are puffy, pillow-edged toy slabs with blob corners, too round next to the flat paper map in the real set
The felt reads as one uniform matte clay surface with no fine material cue; the silhouette, rays and fill are real-card quality
The brass is airbrushed all-over gloss with glow haze, and the hero is a bit small and static on a darker purple field
The pumpkin skin is evenly waxy and the dim table takes up a large lower third; otherwise very close
A busy full garden scene with dense repeated leaf marks and painterly paving, too texture-heavy and cluttered even next to the real swing card
Hardly any tell: crisp truss, a matte body with a shiny lens, and a clean gradient, like the real spotlight-style cards
A spindly chrome chair sits small on a large flat beige slab under a red-orange gradient; weak hero mass and an invented logo
The cap is glossy lacquered plastic rather than cloth, with a bloated crown, and the plank wall and floor are busy
A toy-like rover with blob corners and fat wheels on a speckled pebble ground under a loud neon-green sunburst
